CustomSql.SqlQuery:
WITH usda_with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        commodity_description,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        attribute_id,
        attribute_description,
        month,
        calendar_year,
        value,
        COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(curr_date AS DATE))
        ) AS report_date,
        LAG(COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(curr_date AS DATE))
        )) OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                commodity_code, 
                country_code, 
                attribute_id,
                commodity_description,
                country_name,
                attribute_description
            ORDER BY COALESCE(
                TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
                TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DATE)),
                TRY(CAST(curr_date AS DATE))
            )
        ) AS prev_date,
        LAG(value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                commodity_code, 
                country_code, 
                attribute_id,
                commodity_description,
                country_name,
                attribute_description
            ORDER BY COALESCE(
                TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
                TRY(CAST(date_parse(curr_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DATE)),
                TRY(CAST(curr_date AS DATE))
            )
        ) AS previous_value
    FROM
        shippingbi.usda_psd_table
),
jodi_data_prepared AS (
    SELECT
        energy_product AS commodity_code,
        ref_area AS country_code,
        CASE
            WHEN energy_product = 'CRUDEOIL' THEN 'Crude Oil'
            WHEN energy_product = 'JETKERO' THEN 'Jet Fuel'
            WHEN energy_product = 'GASDIES' THEN 'Diesel'
            WHEN energy_product = 'LPG' THEN 'LPG'
            WHEN energy_product = 'GASOLINE' THEN 'Gasoline'
        END AS sub_commodity,
        CASE
            -- Major oil producers and consumers
            WHEN ref_area = 'US' THEN 'United States'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CN' THEN 'China'
            WHEN ref_area = 'SA' THEN 'Saudi Arabia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'RU' THEN 'Russia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IN' THEN 'India'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CA' THEN 'Canada'
            WHEN ref_area = 'BR' THEN 'Brazil'
            WHEN ref_area = 'MX' THEN 'Mexico'
            WHEN ref_area = 'JP' THEN 'Japan'
            WHEN ref_area = 'KR' THEN 'South Korea'
            WHEN ref_area = 'DE' THEN 'Germany'
            WHEN ref_area = 'GB' THEN 'United Kingdom'
            WHEN ref_area = 'FR' THEN 'France'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IT' THEN 'Italy'
            WHEN ref_area = 'ES' THEN 'Spain'
            WHEN ref_area = 'AU' THEN 'Australia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'ID' THEN 'Indonesia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'TR' THEN 'Turkey'
            WHEN ref_area = 'TH' THEN 'Thailand'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PL' THEN 'Poland'
            WHEN ref_area = 'NL' THEN 'Netherlands'
            WHEN ref_area = 'BE' THEN 'Belgium'
            WHEN ref_area = 'SE' THEN 'Sweden'
            WHEN ref_area = 'NO' THEN 'Norway'
            WHEN ref_area = 'DK' THEN 'Denmark'
            WHEN ref_area = 'FI' THEN 'Finland'
            WHEN ref_area = 'AT' THEN 'Austria'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CH' THEN 'Switzerland'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IE' THEN 'Ireland'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PT' THEN 'Portugal'
            WHEN ref_area = 'GR' THEN 'Greece'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CZ' THEN 'Czech Republic'
            WHEN ref_area = 'HU' THEN 'Hungary'
            WHEN ref_area = 'RO' THEN 'Romania'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IL' THEN 'Israel'
            WHEN ref_area = 'AE' THEN 'United Arab Emirates'
            WHEN ref_area = 'KW' THEN 'Kuwait'
            WHEN ref_area = 'QA' THEN 'Qatar'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IQ' THEN 'Iraq'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IR' THEN 'Iran'
            WHEN ref_area = 'NG' THEN 'Nigeria'
            WHEN ref_area = 'EG' THEN 'Egypt'
            WHEN ref_area = 'ZA' THEN 'South Africa'
            WHEN ref_area = 'AR' THEN 'Argentina'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CL' THEN 'Chile'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CO' THEN 'Colombia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PE' THEN 'Peru'
            WHEN ref_area = 'VE' THEN 'Venezuela'
            WHEN ref_area = 'MY' THEN 'Malaysia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'SG' THEN 'Singapore'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PH' THEN 'Philippines'
            WHEN ref_area = 'VN' THEN 'Vietnam'
            WHEN ref_area = 'NZ' THEN 'New Zealand'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PK' THEN 'Pakistan'
            WHEN ref_area = 'BD' THEN 'Bangladesh'
            WHEN ref_area = 'IS' THEN 'Iceland'
            WHEN ref_area = 'AZ' THEN 'Azerbaijan'
            WHEN ref_area = 'AM' THEN 'Armenia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'BG' THEN 'Bulgaria'
            WHEN ref_area = 'BH' THEN 'Bahrain'
            WHEN ref_area = 'BN' THEN 'Brunei'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CR' THEN 'Costa Rica'
            WHEN ref_area = 'CY' THEN 'Cyprus'
            WHEN ref_area = 'DO' THEN 'Dominican Republic'
            WHEN ref_area = 'DZ' THEN 'Algeria'
            WHEN ref_area = 'EE' THEN 'Estonia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'HK' THEN 'Hong Kong'
            WHEN ref_area = 'HN' THEN 'Honduras'
            WHEN ref_area = 'HR' THEN 'Croatia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PG' THEN 'Papua New Guinea'
            WHEN ref_area = 'PY' THEN 'Paraguay'
            WHEN ref_area = 'SI' THEN 'Slovenia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'SK' THEN 'Slovakia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'SV' THEN 'El Salvador'
            WHEN ref_area = 'TG' THEN 'Togo'
            WHEN ref_area = 'TN' THEN 'Tunisia'
            WHEN ref_area = 'TW' THEN 'Taiwan'
            WHEN ref_area = 'UY' THEN 'Uruguay'
            WHEN ref_area = 'TJ' THEN 'Tajikistan'
            ELSE ref_area
        END AS country_name,
        unit_measure AS unit_id,
        CASE WHEN unit_measure = 'KBD' THEN 'Thousand Barrels per day' END as unit_description,
        flow_breakdown AS attribute_id,
        CASE
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'CLOSTLV' THEN 'Ending Stocks'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'REFGROUT' THEN 'Production'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'INDPROD' THEN 'Production'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'TOTIMPSB' THEN 'Imports'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'TOTEXPSB' THEN 'Exports'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'TOTDEMO' THEN 'Demand'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'STOCKCH' THEN 'Stock Change'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'OSOURCES' THEN 'From other sources'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'DIRECUSE' THEN 'Direct use'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'REFINOBS' THEN 'Refinery intake'
            WHEN flow_breakdown = 'STATDIFF' THEN 'Statistical difference'
            ELSE flow_breakdown
        END AS attribute_description,
        COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE))
        ) AS report_date,
        CAST(obs_value AS DOUBLE) AS current_value,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE))
        )) AS report_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE))
        )) AS report_month
    FROM
        shippingbi.jodi_oil_data
    WHERE
        energy_product IN ('CRUDEOIL', 'JETKERO', 'GASDIES', 'LPG', 'GASOLINE')
        AND obs_value IS NOT NULL
        AND unit_measure in ('KBD')
        AND COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(date, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE))
        ) >= DATE '2024-01-01'
),
jodi_total_supply AS (
    SELECT
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        sub_commodity,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        report_date,
        report_year,
        report_month,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN attribute_id = 'REFGROUT' THEN current_value  -- Production (Refinery Output)
            WHEN attribute_id = 'INDPROD' THEN current_value   -- Production (Indigenous Production)
            WHEN attribute_id = 'TOTIMPSB' THEN current_value  -- Imports
            WHEN attribute_id = 'STOCKCH' THEN current_value   -- Stock Change (positive = drawing from stocks)
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS total_supply_value
    FROM
        jodi_data_prepared
    GROUP BY
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        sub_commodity,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        report_date,
        report_year,
        report_month
),
jodi_combined AS (
    -- Original JODI data
    SELECT
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        sub_commodity,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        attribute_id,
        attribute_description,
        report_date,
        current_value,
        report_year,
        report_month
    FROM
        jodi_data_prepared
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Calculated Total Supply
    SELECT
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        sub_commodity,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        'TOTSUPPLY' AS attribute_id,
        'Total Supply' AS attribute_description,
        report_date,
        total_supply_value AS current_value,
        report_year,
        report_month
    FROM
        jodi_total_supply
),
jodi_with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        sub_commodity,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        attribute_id,
        attribute_description,
        report_date,
        current_value,
        report_year,
        report_month,
        LAG(report_date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                commodity_code, 
                country_code, 
                attribute_id,
                sub_commodity,
                country_name,
                attribute_description
            ORDER BY report_date
        ) AS prev_date,
        LAG(current_value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                commodity_code, 
                country_code, 
                attribute_id,
                sub_commodity,
                country_name,
                attribute_description
            ORDER BY report_date
        ) AS previous_value
    FROM
        jodi_combined
),
-- New CTE for Trading Economics Supply/Demand Commodity Production data
te_production_prepared AS (
    SELECT
        historicaldatasymbol AS commodity_code,
        country AS country_code,
        CASE
            WHEN category = 'Cement Production' THEN 'Cement'
            WHEN category = 'Steel Production' THEN 'Steel'
            ELSE category
        END AS sub_commodity,
        country AS country_name,
        'TE_UNIT' AS unit_id,
        'Thousand Metric Tons' AS unit_description,
        'PRODUCTION' AS attribute_id,
        'Production' AS attribute_description,
        -- Set report_date to the 1st of the month
        DATE_TRUNC('month', COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(datetime, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(datetime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(datetime AS DATE))
        )) AS report_date,
        CAST(value AS DOUBLE) AS current_value,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(datetime, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(datetime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(datetime AS DATE))
        )) AS report_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(datetime, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(date_parse(datetime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE)),
            TRY(CAST(datetime AS DATE))
        )) AS report_month,
        category
    FROM
        shippingbi.te_supply_demand_commodity_production
    WHERE
        category IN ('Cement Production', 'Steel Production')
        AND value IS NOT NULL
),
te_production_with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        commodity_code,
        country_code,
        sub_commodity,
        country_name,
        unit_id,
        unit_description,
        attribute_id,
        attribute_description,
        report_date,
        current_value,
        report_year,
        report_month,
        category,
        LAG(report_date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                commodity_code, 
                country_code, 
                category,
                sub_commodity,
                country_name
            ORDER BY report_date
        ) AS prev_date,
        LAG(current_value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                commodity_code, 
                country_code, 
                category,
                sub_commodity,
                country_name
            ORDER BY report_date
        ) AS previous_value
    FROM
        te_production_prepared
)
-- USDA data with recalculated previous values
SELECT
    CAST(commodity_code AS VARCHAR) AS commodity_code,
    CAST(country_code AS VARCHAR) AS country_code,
    commodity_description AS "Sub-Commodity",
    country_name AS Country,
    CAST(unit_id AS VARCHAR) AS unit_id,
    unit_description,
    CAST(attribute_id AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_id,
    attribute_description,
    CAST(month AS BIGINT) AS month,
    CAST(calendar_year AS BIGINT) AS calendar_year,
    CAST(value AS DOUBLE) AS "current",
    report_date,
    prev_date,
    CAST(previous_value AS DOUBLE) AS "previous",
    CAST((value - previous_value) AS DOUBLE) AS "change",
    
    -- Calculate % change with filter for extreme values
    CASE
        WHEN previous_value IS NOT NULL AND previous_value <> 0
        THEN 
            CASE
                WHEN ABS(((value - previous_value) / previous_value) * 100) > 10000.0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ((value - previous_value) / previous_value) * 100
            END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "% change",

    CASE
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Meal, Rapeseed', 'Oil, Rapeseed', 'Oilseed, Rapeseed') THEN 'Rapeseed'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Meal, Soybean', 'Oil, Soybean', 'Oilseed, Soybean', 'Oilseed, Soybean (Local)', 'Oil, Soybean (Local)','soybeans', 'Meal, Soybean (Local)') THEN 'Soybeans'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Meal, Sunflowerseed', 'Oil, Sunflowerseed', 'Oilseed, Sunflowerseed', 'sunflower') THEN 'Sunflower Oil'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Rice', 'Rice, Milled') THEN 'Rice'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('wheat', 'Wheat') THEN 'Wheat'
        WHEN commodity_description = 'Oats' THEN 'Oat'
        WHEN commodity_description = 'Barley' THEN 'Barley'
        WHEN commodity_description = 'Sorghum' THEN 'Sorghum'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Millet', 'Mixed Grain') THEN 'Other'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Meal, Palm Kernel', 'Oil, Palm', 'Oil, Palm Kernel') THEN 'Other'
        WHEN commodity_description IN ('Oil, Peanut', 'Oilseed, Peanut') THEN 'Other'
        WHEN commodity_description = 'Corn' THEN 'Corn'
        WHEN commodity_description = 'Sugar' THEN 'Sugar'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Commodity"
FROM
    usda_with_previous

UNION ALL

-- JODI data with LAG-based previous values
SELECT
    CAST(commodity_code AS VARCHAR) AS commodity_code,
    CAST(country_code AS VARCHAR) AS country_code,
    sub_commodity AS "Sub-Commodity",
    country_name AS Country,
    CAST(unit_id AS VARCHAR) AS unit_id,
    unit_description,
    CAST(attribute_id AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_id,
    attribute_description,
    CAST(report_month AS BIGINT) AS month,
    CAST(report_year AS BIGINT) AS calendar_year,
    current_value AS "current",
    report_date,
    prev_date,
    previous_value AS "previous",
    (current_value - previous_value) AS "change",
    
    -- Calculate % change with filter for extreme values
    CASE
        WHEN previous_value IS NOT NULL AND previous_value <> 0
        THEN 
            CASE
                WHEN ABS(((current_value - previous_value) / previous_value) * 100) > 1000.0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ((current_value - previous_value) / previous_value) * 100
            END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "% change",
    
    CASE
        WHEN commodity_code = 'CRUDEOIL' THEN 'Crude Oil'
        WHEN commodity_code = 'JETKERO' THEN 'Jet Fuel'
        WHEN commodity_code = 'GASDIES' THEN 'Diesel'
        WHEN commodity_code = 'LPG' THEN 'LPG'
        WHEN commodity_code = 'GASOLINE' THEN 'Gasoline'
    END AS "Commodity"
FROM
    jodi_with_previous

UNION ALL

    CAST(unit_id AS VARCHAR) AS unit_id,

    current_value AS "current",
    report_date,
    prev_date,
    previous_value AS "previous",
    (current_value - previous_value) AS "change",
    
    -- Calculate % change with filter for extreme values
    CASE
        WHEN previous_value IS NOT NULL AND previous_value <> 0
        THEN

                WHEN ABS(((current_value - previous_value) / previous_value) * 100) > 1000.0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ((current_value - previous_value) / previous_value) * 100
